measurementScope: Tauri desktop click-to-first-batch and click-to-first-React-interactive measures emitted by production Performance marks. Aggregate durations only; no query text, rows, connection identifiers, or credentials.

steps: Start the desktop app with pnpm dev:app and open its WebView developer tools.
Run at least 10 row-producing read interactions against a configured local test connection.
Run the snippet command, paste its output into the WebView console, and save the emitted duration-only JSON.
Run the record command with that JSON, then run pnpm check:query-grid.
